metadata.description:
A cultural organization wants to understand Creative Europe Cooperation Projects.
They want to know the difference between small, medium, and large-scale projects,
and get guidance on which category fits their 3-partner consortium. The scenario
tests understanding of partnership requirements, funding rates, and scale selection.
